title: jamesonia glaberrima
intro: Jamesonia glaberrima, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
